methodology.cpu: untraced process-tree user+system+reaped-child seconds / monotonic elapsed; 100% = one core
methodology.memory: sum smaps_rollup PSS; excludes GPU memory
methodology.startup: Popen to first accessible button; warm desktop/cache, not login or all data ready
methodology.sampling: 15s after 3s warmup; observer runs outside measured/traced app tree; checks X11 map state every sample
methodology.resume: 17 completed runs preserved after transient AT-SPI null-node failure; remaining 11 resumed with identical binary hashes/config/client count. First failed trace group manually verified and terminated. Original profile bytes were not persisted by initial harness; resume restored its own starting test profile. User profile was never targeted.
methodology.comparison: historical 47fa999 baseline has different workload/client count; only e6fd7b0 matched runs support optimization claims
methodology.limitations: two untraced Studio repeats per build; one per other phase, no statistical significance or cold start claim; short-lived reparented children may escape CPU attribution; desktop has other active applications
